job.location: Various School Sites in Newport Beach and Costa Mesa, CA

items.item_text: 01. Information I provide to the following supplemental questions will be reviewed as part of the application process. Questions that are not fully and completely answered will be considered grounds for disqualification from the examination process. Stating "see resume" in lieu of a complete response to these questions is not acceptable. Select "Yes" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
02. Do you have a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No
03. Has your education included college-level coursework in business, office management or related field? Options: Yes | No
04. How many years of verifiable increasingly responsible job work related clerical or secretarial experience do you have? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 3-4 years | 5 years or more

05. How many years of verifiable job related clerical work experience do you have involving public contact either in person or on the phone? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 3-4 years | 5 years or more

06. How many years of verifiable job related work experience do you have performing oral and written translations to/from English and Spanish? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 3-4 years | 5 years or more
07. Check the box that most closely matches your speed in typing or keyboarding. Options: Less than 40 wpm | 40-44 wpm | 45-49 wpm | 50-54 wpm | 55-59 wpm | 60-69 wpm | 70 wpm or faster

08. Check the box that indicates your level of proficiency with Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint). Options: None. I have no experience in working with Microsoft Office software products. | Beginner. Perform daily word processing tasks in Word, enter correct data, create a database, format cells, rows and columns in Excel; create a PowerPoint presentation file with a title slide, bullet points and place in slide loop mode; create a new email message, checking email in Outlook. | Intermediate. Basic formatting and create a variety of templates, mail merges in Word; create, modify and format charts, use graphic objects to enhance worksheets and charts in Excel; add special effects to presentation (design and animation) in PowerPoint; reply, forward, print and delete email messages in Outlook. | Advanced. Manage table data, sort and filter merges in Word; use the filter and formula functions to manipulate data in Excel; transition presentation slides, link Excel charts to presentation and add voice in PowerPoint; delete e-mails from the Inbox, Sent Items and Deleted Items folders, add, edit, move and delete appointments on your calendar in Outlook. | Expert. Produce table of contents, footnotes, endnotes, bookmarks in Word; use advance formula functions, manage macro commands, group rows in Excel; publish presentation online, embed objects into presentation in PowerPoint; manage multiple calendars, set rules for incoming mail, create subfolders for mail to be placed in Outlook.

09. According to the job announcement, check the box that most closely matches your level of proficiency to perform the minimum qualifications listed: Respond to requests for information and/or services. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

10. Coordinate and schedule meetings, conferences, training sessions, etc. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

11. Screen calls and visitors and handle or route to appropriate staff. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

12. Compose documents such as emails, letters, memos, reports, forms, bulletins and newsletters. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

13. Process documents such as time sheets, work orders, requisitions, travel requests and expense claims and review them for accuracy. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

14. Monitor budgets to ensure consistency with budget controls and program requirements. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

15. Order and maintain inventories of office equipment, supplies and contracts. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

16. Establish priorities for carrying out multiple tasks in order to meet deadlines. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

17. Describe your work related experience managing multiple projects with varying deadlines while ensuring accuracy of your work. Include the techniques you utilized to stay organized and be successful.

18. This position requires frequent interaction with students, parents, administrators and other staff. Describe your experience dealing with a variety of customers with diverse requests and needs. What techniques do you use to ensure excellent customer service for all stakeholders?
19. Describe your work related experience monitoring expenditures, initiating budget transfers and arranging expense reimbursements for a manager or administrator.
20. Describe specific actions you have taken to promote a cooperative team environment, even when others around you were negative or uncooperative. What did you do and what were the results?

ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Oversee the front office activities of an assigned Alternative Campus High School; coordinate communication between the Principal's office and faculty, students, parents and outside organizations. Provide clerical assistance to the Principal, staff and faculty as required; scan and photocopy documents; prepare, type and distribute email and written communications to faculty, District and school staff. Greet and provide information to students, staff and the public concerning school policies, procedures, actions, activities and schedules as appropriate; assist students and parents with the proper completion of forms and applications; review completed forms for accuracy and completeness; process forms and related materials. Initiate and answer phone calls and take messages; provide information and assistance to students, teachers, parents and others regarding school functions and activities; assist with registration functions as assigned; schedule dates and assist with the completion of forms. Assist students, staff and visitors regarding attendance issues; place and receive phone calls and accept notes regarding student absences; process and verify student absence information from parents and teachers; issue admission and tardy slips to returning students to assure accurate absentee reporting. Maintain payroll for certificated, classified and other personnel; maintain accurate records of substitute teachers and accounts to be charged. Request substitutes as required; assist in orienting substitute personnel; provide keys and instructional materials and maintain related records. Collect and account for monies collected in conjunction with school activities and supplies including club accounts, ASB funds, yearbooks, field trips, grants, donations, restricted funds, donations, student activities, transportation and other fees in accordance with established procedures; prepare and make bank deposits. Maintain accurate and current student emergency release information; oversee the release of students to authorized parents, guardians or approved individuals. Lead and provide work direction to the activities of classified staff; assure compliance with established procedures; assist in setting work priorities. Research, compile and verify a variety of information; compute statistical information for a variety of reports; process and evaluate a variety of forms and applications related to assigned functions; duplicate and distribute materials as needed. Prepare and maintain a variety of data, records and reports related to office programs, financial activity, student information, personnel and assigned duties including permanent records, cumulative folders, transcript files and demographic information; assure accuracy and completeness of data, records and reports; establish and maintain filing systems. Prepare purchase orders for various departments utilizing an assigned database; maintain records concerning assigned budgets; monitor assigned budgets and funds; identify appropriate products to procure as required; communicate with vendors and outside organizations to rectify shipping inaccuracies or issues. Perform accounting and financial record-keeping duties to assure sound fiscal management of student body and school funds; assure compliance with applicable provisions of the California Education Code. Receive, sort and distribute mail; open mail and compose responses independently as appropriate; prepare and distribute informational packets and bulk mailings as directed. Operate a variety of office equipment including a computer and assigned software. Administer basic first aid and screen ill or injured students as assigned in accordance with State laws and District regulations; call paramedics as needed. OTHER DUTIES: Perform related duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: KNOWLEDGE OF: Modern office practices, procedures and equipment. Statistical record keeping techniques. Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation and vocabulary. Oral and written communication skills. Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy. Telephone techniques and etiquette. District organization, operations, policies and objectives. Basic first aid techniques. Operation of standard office equipment including computer and assigned software. ABILITY TO: Perform a wide variety of clerical and secretarial duties to coordinate school office activities. Perform public relations and communications services for the Principal. Understand and follow oral and written directions. Compose correspondence independently. Complete work with many interruptions. Work independently with little direction. Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others. Type and input data at an acceptable rate of speed. Learn, interpret, apply and explain rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Operate a variety of office machines including a computer and assigned software. Understand and work within the scope of authority. Plan and organize work. Train and provide work direction to others. Work confidentially with discretion. Plan and organize work. Administer first aid. WORKING CONDITIONS: ENVIRONMENT: Office environment. Constant interruptions. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard and other office equipment. Sitting for extended periods of time. Kneeling, bending at the waist, and reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally to retrieve and store files and supplies. Hearing and speaking to exchange information in person or on the telephone. Seeing to read, prepare and assure the accuracy of documents. HAZARDS: Contact with blood and bloodborne pathogens. Potential contact with communicable diseases. Contact with abusive individuals. Ewing Consulting, Inc. August 2016
